serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Enterprise FedRAMP Cloud Service Offering incorporating policy-enforced AI agent services for federal acquisition research (Class C) and mission cyber incident triage (Class D) with CoSAI Risk Map ADR-030 Policy Enforcement Point isolation.

serviceProperties.digitalIdentityLevel: Class C: IAL2/AAL2/FAL2; Class D: IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 via Agency OIDC/SAML SSO with JWE/XML-Enc encrypted assertions
serviceProperties.digitalIdentityReadiness: Production identity plane enforces NIST SP 800-63-4 digital identity assurance levels per CTL.IA.IA-05. Local password bypass is disabled for all federal tenants. Short-lived audience-scoped tokens govern every downstream agent tool invocation.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Public Trust Center providing machine-readable Certification Package Overview (CPO), Secure Configuration Guidance (SCG), and quarterly Ongoing Certification Reports (OCR).

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Customer and administrator guidance for configuring agent tool allowlists, dual consent surfaces, SSO assertion encryption, and egress Policy Enforcement Points.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Automated nightly KSI and agent-manifest evaluation evidence repository.
Entitlement-gated access to Security Decision Records (SDR), per-service certification artifacts (CDS-CSO-PSM), SCN notices, and VDR/VER reports.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Request a per-party entitlement credential from high-compliance@example-govcloud-cso.gov citing your agency, official purpose, and package ID FR2699001122.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: In-boundary runtime CSO agent providing citation-grounded acquisition research and document drafting within an isolated workspace container protected by Application, Agent Network, Model Serving, and Tool Authorization Policy Enforcement Points.
certifiedServices.securityCategory: FIPS 199 Moderate (Class C: confidentiality Moderate, integrity Moderate, availability Moderate)

certifiedServices.serviceName: High-Impact Mission Cyber & Incident Triage Agent (mission-incident-response-agent-d)
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: U.S.-jurisdiction sovereign runtime CSO agent performing automated vulnerability correlation (VER-TFR-EVU 2-day SLA) and incident PAIN triage with FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSM cryptography and IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 identity enforcement.
certifiedServices.securityCategory: FIPS 199 High (Class D: confidentiality High, integrity High, availability High)

certified.name: AWS GovCloud (US)
certified.useCase: Sovereign cloud hosting, FIPS 140-3 cryptographic modules, private VPC endpoints, dedicated inference compute, and immutable Object Lock WORM audit storage.
certified.generalUsageAndConfiguration: All runtime agent containers, model weights, vector stores, and audit repositories operate exclusively in AWS GovCloud (US-East/US-West) regions under U.S. jurisdiction.
certified.justification: Provides inherited FedRAMP High physical, environmental, and foundational infrastructure controls.
mitigationMeasures: Enforce VPC endpoint policies and Network Egress PEP allowlists preventing any public internet egress from inference or tool subnets.
Encrypt all data at rest and in transit using active FIPS 140-3 validated modules (CMU-CSO-UVM).
compensatingControls: Separate control-plane audit record repository (CoSAI componentAuditRecordRepository) with WORM retention and cryptographic digest chaining.
Automated nightly configuration drift and KSI verification.

nonCertified.name: Internal DevSecOps CI/CD & Compliance Evidence Pipeline
nonCertified.useCase: Source control, deterministic manifest and neutrality validation, container image signing, and automated compliance evidence generation.
nonCertified.generalUsageAndConfiguration: Self-hosted ephemeral build runners executing inside isolated management subnets; zero Federal Customer Data or production prompts/responses enter this plane.
nonCertified.justification: Required for repeatable software delivery, vulnerability scanning (VDR), and automated SDR/OCR artifact publication.
mitigationMeasures: Enforce prompt_response_redacted_from_external_telemetry and block all production data paths to CI/CD systems (MAS-CSO-MDI).
Pin all build tools by SHA-256 digest and sign release artifacts with FIPS-backed keys.
compensatingControls: Mandatory pre-commit and CI gates executing validate_manifest.py, check_neutrality.py, and audit_agent_repo.py on every pull request.

documentationOverview.name: Security Decision Record (SDR) & Per-Service Agent Addenda
documentationOverview.availability: Supplied to authorized agency and assessment personnel via Controlled Certification Package channel (CDS-CSO-PSM)

servicesOutsideMinimumAssessmentScope.reason: Neither handles Federal Customer Data/metadata nor connects to, administers, builds, or deploys the certified CSO or its in-scope agents (MAS-CSO-IIR / MAS-CSO-SUP).

changeNotificationMechanism.description: All Significant Change Notifications (SCN) affecting agent architectures, model serving endpoints, TPIRs, or security boundaries are published as signed Markdown and JSON records with SHA-256 delivery receipts.

incidentNotificationMechanism.mechanism: FedRAMP security email, agency-specific verified channels, and controlled Trust Center feed
incidentNotificationMechanism.description: Delivers Initial, Ongoing, and Final Incident Reports per CR-26 IEC rules and VER-TFR-IRI / VER-TFR-NRI vulnerability escalation triggers.
